description: Live probes on 2026-11-09 observed distinct missing-role HTTP 404 messages: GET returned 'NOT_FOUND: Role <uuid> not found'; PATCH with a name on a confirmed absent UUID returned 'NOT_FOUND: Roles not found: <uuid>'; the Alchemy lifecycle suite's duplicate DELETE returned 'NOT_FOUND: Some of the roles not found'. Match only these role-specific messages through one shared RoleNotFound class on GET, PATCH, and DELETE.

com.distilled.openapi#errorMatchers.message: NOT_FOUND: Some of the roles not found
